items.title: Vampire Playing a Small Organ
items.alt: A seated vampire with swept silver hair plays a compact wooden keyboard with five simple organ pipes.
items.description: A seated vampire with swept silver hair plays a compact wooden keyboard with five simple organ pipes. Useful for music story prompts.

items.title: Vampire Offering a Rose
items.alt: A shy young vampire with wavy dark hair offers one peach rose, other hand resting against a teal waistcoat.
items.description: A shy young vampire with wavy dark hair offers one peach rose, other hand resting against a teal waistcoat. Useful for personal greeting cards.

items.title: Vampire Carrying a Lantern

items.description: A cheerful vampire girl with two short braids walks holding a small enclosed lantern in front of her. Useful for night adventure cards.
